A small refactor of ModeController and VisualizationTable.

This commit aims to reduce the amount of repeated code in the
ModeController. Moves all the logic to update data in the tableView to
the updateTableRows()-method, that is called by the runnable.
Added test for OnShelf.

Changed use of TestDataLoader to DataLoader.

TestDataLoader should only be used by test. For this reason we have
changed to DataLoader in ModeController's initialize().

A first try at a refactor.

Has adressed most of the issues regarding the non-modularity of the
TableRow-class (former Aggregate). Is now modular, and a new table just
needs a new Class that implements the TableRow interface.

Changed name from Row to TableRow.

This is done because it corresponds to the TableColumn used in the
TableView. Clearer understanding of the role of the class.

Small refactor of TableLoader.

Doesn't need to create several instances of a TableLoader. Replaced

Had duplicate database.sql file, but this was not needed. Resolved
